Same service

This service page and the next one are nearly identical on purpose so the near-duplicate detector can find them. They describe the same imaginary offer with the same sentences, the same deliverables, the same setup steps and the same frequently asked questions. A real site should never publish two pages that compete with each other like this.

The checklist includes a product list, a stock sheet, invoice templates and a weekly review. Setup starts with a call, continues with configuration and ends with a records review. Supported tools depend on the country and the business. Human review is required for AI-assisted output. Contact information and next steps are repeated here in the same order.

Because the words repeat across both files, the five-gram similarity should be close to one. The audit should flag the pair and suggest differentiating or merging the pages. The metadata is also duplicated, which is a second signal that these are not distinct pages.
